mods.name: Linkle
mods.author: pokisofiii
mods.description:
Tada!~

Say hello to Toon Linkle! This mod fully replaces Hero of the Winds with Linkle.
In the style of Nintendo, I thought it fitting to release a smaller mod to hold some of you guys over while waiting for Linkle 3.0!

This expressive and adorable girl has stumbled her way into a whole new game, and she can't wait to meet you! Help her keep her vow to save Hyrule in a bouncy, fun, and sweet story that will keep you smiling all the way through!

This mod features a fully custom model, made from scratch! A special thanks to SariaOfTheKokiri for making the female dialogue patch which is included in this mod as well as the model replacement tutorial that helped me get started making this.
